# rt/mem

> Raw memory: an allocator on mmap, plus copy, fill, compare and pointer arithmetic.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/mem.pkg)

The foundation of the `rt` truck, written in Packenger with system calls.

```
let p = mem_alloc(16)          // ptr u8 to 16 zeroed bytes
*mem_add(p, 3) = 'x'
mem_copy(q, p, 16)
print mem_eq(p, q, 16)         // true
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `mem_alloc(n: int) -> ptr u8` | `n` zeroed bytes, 8-byte aligned; never freed |
| `mem_add(p: ptr u8, n: int) -> ptr u8` | the address `n` bytes after `p` |
| `mem_copy(dst: ptr u8, src: ptr u8, n: int)` | copy `n` bytes (8 at a time); the ranges must not overlap |
| `mem_set(dst: ptr u8, b: u8, n: int)` | fill `n` bytes with `b` |
| `mem_eq(a: ptr u8, b: ptr u8, n: int) -> bool` | are the first `n` bytes equal |
| `rt_panic(msg: str)` | write `msg` and a newline to stderr and exit with status 2 |

`mem_alloc` is a bump allocator: it takes 64 MB chunks (or a larger one
for a larger request) from the kernel with `mmap` and hands them out in
order. It is separate from the heap `new` and `make` use.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
const MEM_CHUNK = 67108864

global mem_next: int = 0
global mem_end: int = 0

fn rt_panic(msg: str)
  syscall(1, 2, cstr(msg), len(msg))
  syscall(1, 2, cstr("\n"), 1)
  syscall(60, 2)
end

fn mem_alloc(n: int) -> ptr u8
  if n < 0
    rt_panic("rt/mem: negative allocation size")
  end
  let size = (n + 7) & -8
  if mem_next + size > mem_end
    let chunk = MEM_CHUNK
    if size > chunk
      chunk = size
    end
    // mmap(NULL, chunk, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0)
    let fresh = syscall(9, 0, chunk, 3, 34, -1, 0)
    if fresh < 0
      rt_panic("rt/mem: out of memory")
    end
    mem_next = fresh
    mem_end = fresh + chunk
  end
  let p = mem_next
  mem_next = mem_next + size
  return p as ptr u8
end

fn mem_add(p: ptr u8, n: int) -> ptr u8
  return ((p as int) + n) as ptr u8
end

fn mem_copy(dst: ptr u8, src: ptr u8, n: int)
  let d = dst as int
  let s = src as int
  let i = 0
  while i + 8 <= n
    *((d + i) as ptr int) = *((s + i) as ptr int)
  next
    i = i + 8
  end
  while i < n
    *((d + i) as ptr u8) = *((s + i) as ptr u8)
  next
    i = i + 1
  end
end

fn mem_set(dst: ptr u8, b: u8, n: int)
  let d = dst as int
  for i = 0 to n - 1
    *((d + i) as ptr u8) = b
  end
end

fn mem_eq(a: ptr u8, b: ptr u8, n: int) -> bool
  let x = a as int
  let y = b as int
  let i = 0
  while i + 8 <= n
    if *((x + i) as ptr int) != *((y + i) as ptr int)
      return false
    end
  next
    i = i + 8
  end
  while i < n
    if *((x + i) as ptr u8) != *((y + i) as ptr u8)
      return false
    end
  next
    i = i + 1
  end
  return true
end
```
